candidate_067.name: non-stationary evidence-informed belief state with bounded retrieval and belief-sensitive search control
candidate_067.mechanism_hypothesis: Treat each verified result as evidence that changes the agent's current epistemic state. Before scoring or selecting a new hypothesis, retrieve a bounded set of source-relevant prior verified discoveries, update the current prior belief, and distinguish genuine information gain from a result already implied by accumulated evidence. Use this updated belief state in explicit hypothesis-selection controls: filter already-implied candidates, maintain semantic diversity, and remove near-duplicates online. Do not assume that merely swapping a scalar novelty/reward score will redirect search; the changed belief must alter the candidate-selection control flow. Preserve a route for conflicting stronger evidence so belief saturation does not permanently suppress legitimate revisitation.

primary_evidence.source: Evidence-Informed LLM Beliefs for Continual Scientific Discovery, Agarwal et al., arXiv:2606.29182v1, 28 Jun 2026
primary_evidence.design: AutoDiscovery-based open-ended data-driven discovery across five real-world domains from DiscoveryBench and BLADE. Belief-updating experiments use GPT-5-mini on three repeats per domain; search experiments use GPT-4o as discovery agent plus GPT-5-mini as belief model, three repeat runs, n=500 experiments per run. The paper compares full-context, top-k embedding retrieval and Mem0-style structured memory, then ablates belief-update filtering, diversity maximization, static versus non-stationary reward and online de-duplication.

results.human_nonstationarity_check: In neuroscience and social-science expert studies, experts changed their prior belief after seeing the top-5 similar prior discoveries in 48.07% and 52% of cases. Among hypotheses AutoDiscovery had labeled surprising, experts judged prior discoveries informative enough to undermine novelty in 29.54% of 44 neuroscience cases and 25% of 32 social-science cases.
results.belief_update_quality: Top-25 embedding retrieval produced the strongest average reduction in static surprisal: 31.8 fewer surprisals relative to 85.1 static surprisals, versus 28.2 fewer for full context and 23.5 for Mem0. Across the broader analysis, evidence-informed priors lower the static surprisal count by about 37.5%.
results.bounded_context_boundary: In an n=800 longer-horizon comparison, full context had 6.1 percentage points greater total surprisal (about 23 hypotheses) than top-25 retrieval while costing 8.45x as many tokens on average. Performance was not monotonic in retrieval size: k=5 and k=25 were strongest, while k=1, k=50 and all-context were worse in the reported comparison.
results.search_control_effect: Across five discovery domains and three repeats at n=500, evidence-informed search with non-stationary beliefs and online de-duplication achieved a 30.63% gain (about 41 additional non-stationary surprisals) over standard static-reward search and 13.37% (about 21) over standard search plus online de-duplication. Removing diversity maximization, belief-update filtering or online de-duplication each degraded cumulative non-stationary surprisal.
results.reward_only_negative: Simply replacing static surprisal reward with non-stationary surprisal had inconsistent/negligible effect on discovery yield and did not materially change semantic diversity; explicit candidate-selection mechanisms were required.

primary_evidence.interpretation: This is direct science-domain evidence that continual discovery should update the frame of reference for novelty/information value as evidence accumulates, and that bounded relevant retrieval can outperform both exhaustive context replay and a generic structured-memory baseline. It also gives a useful control-flow result: updating an evaluator/reward signal alone is insufficient unless the belief change changes what experiments are selected.
primary_evidence.limits: The principal success metric is accumulated non-stationary surprisal, itself elicited through an LLM belief model rather than an external scientific truth metric. Belief estimates depend on prompting, sampling variance and calibration. The authors warn that filtering can suppress hypotheses legitimately worth revisiting under stronger or conflicting evidence. Experiments are controlled finite-budget data-driven discovery, not an unrestricted laboratory scientist. The fixed top-25 and belief-shift threshold 0.2 are study-specific, not universal constants.

corroborating_evidence.source: BayesEvolve: Explicit Belief States for Autonomous Scientific Discovery, Wu et al., arXiv:2606.30335v1, 29 Jun 2026
corroborating_evidence.design: Controlled shifted BBOB-style 5D black-box optimization testbed with five benchmark functions and five random seeds. All LLM methods use gpt-5.4-mini and differ in state/context; comparisons include Random-LLM, Archive-LLM, Memory-LLM and a GP posterior belief state. Local decision-rule ablations share initialization, GP posterior and candidate-pool mechanism.
corroborating_evidence.results: At 100 evaluations, normalized best-so-far objective was 0.195+/-0.043 for BayesEvolve versus 0.473+/-0.074 Archive-LLM and 0.425+/-0.069 Memory-LLM; GP-BO was 0.229+/-0.047. Across 60,800 held-out belief predictions, posterior mean had Spearman rho=0.774 with realized values, but calibration was imperfect (one-sigma coverage 0.433; two-sigma 0.653). In local ablation, Archive was 0.333+/-0.059, mean-only predictive belief 0.177+/-0.047, and decaying-UCB 0.174+/-0.045 final normalized best.
corroborating_evidence.scope: Supports explicit predictive/uncertainty-aware belief states over unstructured archive memory under a fixed budget, but the paper explicitly leaves program and laboratory discovery to future work; use as controlled corroboration, not direct scientific-discovery proof.

candidate_067.relation_to_existing: Extends candidate_065's auditable hypothesis-evidence-belief lifecycle with direct evidence that the active belief reference should be non-stationary and should change search allocation. Complements candidate_057/058/062 by showing a bounded relevant active context can beat full replay, and candidate_063/064 by giving matched ablations where belief state, diversity control and online redundancy suppression alter the next-hypothesis policy. It does not yet supply event sourcing or explicit stale-belief revocation.

preregistered_panel.progress: The official Hugging Face dataset path and exact 5.69 MB MiniMax-M3 file remain verified, and an official per-file commit-diff transport pattern was independently observed on another file from the same source commit. However, the exact target-filtered diff URL is not surfaced by search or a trusted link and the browsing safety layer rejects constructed URLs; raw target transport still exceeds the 4 MiB text limit. No target content was inferred, the seven-model partial aggregate was not computed, and no later task was substituted.

parallel_frontier_search.event_sourced_belief_plus_revocation: Narrowed but still open. Candidate_067 now gives science-domain evidence for non-stationary belief updates plus bounded top-k active retrieval and search-policy changes; BayesEvolve adds controlled uncertainty-aware predictive belief evidence. A same-system science experiment that also includes append-only/event-sourced provenance plus explicit stale-belief revocation remains unidentified.
parallel_frontier_search.matched_mandatory_science_repair: Still open. Sibyl-AutoResearch supplies realistic auditable examples in which weak/stale/unsupported trial outcomes were blocked, downgraded or routed to repair, but its authors explicitly state that the traces do not establish comparative performance. No same-model/same-tools/same-budget open-ended science randomization of optional critique versus mandatory evidence-changing repair/downgrade/block was found.
parallel_frontier_search.fresh_root_restart: Still open in autonomous science. ScienceFlow supports validated executable-state re-anchoring rather than a full cold restart, and SWE-domain FailFast-RestartSmart supports fresh same-policy restart with optional artifact carry-over; no science-domain matched full fresh-root restart versus continued repair comparison was found.

termination_diagnostics.blocker: Exact MiniMax-M3 W4409116437 remains uncoded because its public file exceeds the current direct text transport boundary and the exact target-filtered official diff URL is not safely surfaced for opening.

exact_next_action: Retry exactly MiniMax-M3 W4409116437 only through a legitimate surfaced public chunk/range/Xet/mirror or exact target-filtered diff; do not score seven models or advance lexicographically until the eighth body is readable. In parallel, search for a science-domain same-system composition of event-sourced hypothesis/evidence state, explicit stale-belief revocation and bounded active retrieval; search same-model/same-tools/same-budget optional-critique versus mandatory evidence-changing repair/block and science-domain full fresh-root restart versus continued-repair comparisons; test whether candidate_067's belief filtering remains beneficial under contradictory/new evidence rather than only redundancy suppression.
